response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), sh AS (SELECT link_to_member, s, s * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(s) FROM g) AS share FROM g), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh) SELECT SUM(s) AS total_sum, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM av)) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM sh WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM av)
